content.short: Keyrails settles high value trade payments across emerging markets in hours using SWIFT and local clearing systems.
content.description: Keyrails handles the payments behind import, export and commodity trade, where a single invoice can run to seven figures and a delay costs a shipment. It reaches more than 100 markets and settles in hours rather than days by combining SWIFT connectivity with direct access to local real time gross settlement systems, covering over 65 currencies. Businesses that build a payment history on the network can also draw dollar working capital against it, which matters in corridors where trade finance is hard to come by. The company is based in Calgary.
